hero.headline: Every community has problems. Every young person has the potential to create solutions.
hero.text: The Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge (ECIC) is a student-focused innovation initiative that encourages secondary school students to identify real challenges within their communities, develop practical solutions, and present their ideas.

about.heading: What is the Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge?
paragraphs: The Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge is a community-focused initiative powered by Edunotech.
It is built on the belief that young people should not be viewed only as future contributors to society. They can also begin developing solutions to real challenges within their communities today.
Through ECIC, students are encouraged to observe their environments, identify problems, think critically, explore possible solutions, and communicate their ideas.
The challenge provides a platform for students to move beyond discussing problems and begin taking responsibility for understanding and addressing them.
about.pullQuote: ECIC is not simply about building technology. It is about developing people who can think, create, and contribute meaningfully.

why.title: Developing Problem Solvers
why.text: Encouraging students to become more observant, analytical, and solution-oriented.

why.title: Connecting Ideas to Reality
why.text: Helping participants move from identifying challenges to developing practical and relevant solutions.

why.title: Building Confidence and Responsibility
why.text: Creating opportunities for students to communicate their ideas, collaborate, and take initiative.

why.title: Encouraging Community Innovation
why.text: Promoting the idea that meaningful solutions can emerge from a deeper understanding of local challenges.

stages.title: Problem Discovery and Learning
paragraphs: Students are introduced to problem-solving, innovation, and the importance of understanding real challenges.
They explore their environments and identify problems that may be worth addressing.

stages.title: Idea Development and Selection
paragraphs: Students develop their ideas and communicate their proposed solutions.
Submitted ideas are reviewed through the challenge's selection process, with promising teams or participants progressing to the next stage.

stages.title: Grand Finale
paragraphs: Selected innovators present their solutions before an audience and an evaluation panel.
The finale provides an opportunity to showcase ideas, recognise promising innovators, and encourage continued development.

stagesNote: The precise format, eligibility requirements, selection criteria, and award details are confirmed for each edition.

edition2026.heading: The Journey So Far: ECIC 2026
paragraphs: The 2026 edition of the Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge brought together students through a journey centred on problem identification, idea development, and practical innovation.
The programme culminated in its Grand Finale on 26 September 2026.
Beyond the final presentations, the intention is to continue supporting the innovators as they develop their ideas, learn from mentors, and explore opportunities for growth.

edition2027.heading: The Next Chapter: ECIC 2027
paragraphs: We are looking ahead to the next edition of the Edunotech Community Innovation Challenge.
ECIC 2027 will build on the foundation of the previous edition, with a continued commitment to encouraging young people to identify problems, think creatively, and develop practical solutions.
We also believe the ECIC community should grow beyond the students who participate as innovators.
Previous innovators, volunteers, mentors, educators, organisations, and other interested individuals can contribute to the planning and development of future editions.

partnership.heading: Help Us Build a Generation That Creates Solutions.
